title: Open edX OLX Grading Policy
description: Authoring schema for the grading_policy.json policy file used by Open edX.

GRADER.description: Assignment types used to calculate the course grade.

gradeCutoffs.description: Mapping of grade labels to minimum overall course grades.

type.description: Assignment type name matched by graded subsections.

min_count.description: Minimum number of assignments expected for this assignment type.

drop_count.description: Number of lowest-scoring assignments to drop.

short_label.description: Optional short label used when displaying the assignment type.

weight.description: Contribution of this assignment type to the overall course grade.
